WITH per_group AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneref,
    st.typesite,
    AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio,
    AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_pressratio) AS avg_of_group_avg_pressratio,
  AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS avg_of_group_avg_size_per_minute
FROM per_group;

assumptions.assumption: The text timestamps are ISO-formatted consistently, so lexicographic comparison gives the requested inclusive time range. The site join is an inner join, retaining only scans linked to a site code.
